title: Memory Masters
description: Sharpen your photographic recall! Match hidden pairs of holographic neon symbols, chain rapid discoveries for combo bonuses, and clear the memory matrix against the clock.
instructions: Click or tap cards to flip them over and reveal their hidden cyber glyphs.
Uncover two identical symbols in succession to lock them in as a matched pair.
Chain consecutive matches together to build an immense combo multiplier.
Clear all 8 pairs before the round timer reaches zero!
controls: Mouse Click / Mobile Tap: Flip cards
